title: UTCS Tax Result
description: The canonical output of all UTCS tax determination operations. This schema is strictly defined and invariant across all providers. Every compliant provider returns data in this identical structure.

result_id.description: Unique identifier for this result. Provider-generated.

total_tax.description: Total tax across all lines and jurisdictions. Reflects any applied tax_override.

total_tax_calculated.description: Total tax the engine computed from rates and rules, before any tax_override. Present only when an override changed the result; equals total_tax otherwise.

total_exempt.description: Total exempt amount (exempted by certificate or entity status).

total_non_taxable.description: Total non-taxable amount across all lines. Non-taxable means not subject to tax by product or jurisdiction taxability rule, distinct from exempt.

total_discount.description: Total discount allocated across all lines. Echoes the transaction-level discount the provider applied when reducing the taxable basis.

currency_code.description: ISO 4217 currency code for all amounts.

lines.description: Per-line tax results. Each entry corresponds to an input line.

tax_amount.description: Total tax for this line across all jurisdictions. Reflects any applied tax_override.

tax_calculated.description: Tax the engine computed for this line from rates and rules, before any tax_override. Present only when an override changed the line; equals tax_amount otherwise.

exempt_amount.description: Amount exempt from tax by certificate or entity status.

non_taxable_amount.description: Amount not subject to tax by product or jurisdiction taxability rule (distinct from exempt_amount). taxable_amount + exempt_amount + non_taxable_amount reconciles to the line's taxable basis (line amount net of any allocated discount).

discount_amount.description: Discount allocated to this line from the transaction-level discount (present only when a discount was applied and this line was flagged discounted). Reduces the taxable basis.

tax_code.description: Tax code applied. May differ from input if the provider reclassified.

tax_code_description.description: Human-readable description of the applied tax code.

jurisdictions.description: Per-jurisdiction breakdown of taxes applied to this line.

Optional order-level rollup of tax by jurisdiction across the whole transaction. Each entry sums one taxing jurisdiction's tax over all lines. This is a convenience AGGREGATION; the authoritative per-line, per-jurisdiction detail stays in lines[].jurisdictions[]. A jurisdiction that appears on several lines is collapsed into a single entry here.

jurisdiction_code.description: Standardized jurisdiction identifier. Interpreted according to jurisdiction_code_system.

jurisdiction_code_system.description: Code system that jurisdiction_code is drawn from. Matches the value used in the per-line breakdown.

tax_type.description: Type of tax levied by this jurisdiction. Provider-derived OUTPUT.

taxable_amount.description: Amount subject to this jurisdiction's tax, summed across all lines.

tax_amount.description: Tax for this jurisdiction, summed across all lines.

attestation.description: Provider attestation identifying who calculated the tax, using what content, and when.

conformance.description: Conformance profiles the provider applied when producing this result (OUTPUT annotation). Each profile is declared in the provider manifest under conformance_profiles. Not supplied by the caller. Example: a US sale returns [{"id":"us-sst"}]; a cross-border EU invoice returns [{"id":"en16931"}].

id.description: Conformance profile identifier applied to this result.

messages.description: Informational, warning, and error notices the provider raised while calculating (e.g., an address was corrected, a tax code was defaulted, nexus was not established). Advisory OUTPUT; the caller SHOULD surface warnings.

code.description: Provider-specific message code for programmatic handling.

refers_to.description: Optional pointer to the part of the request the message concerns (e.g., "lines[0]", "addresses.ship_to").

source.description: Optional subsystem that raised the message (e.g., "address_validation", "nexus", "classification").

adjustment.description: Present when status is 'adjusted'. Explains why the committed transaction was adjusted and links to the prior result.

reason.description: Reason code or category for the adjustment.

adjusted_from_result_id.description: result_id of the result this one supersedes.
